channel.title: Paksh: International
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Russia Attacks Ukrainian Ports and Energy Infrastructure
item.description: Russia has escalated attacks on Ukrainian ports, increasing risks for shipping. Additionally, Russian forces have targeted Ukraine's energy grid, leading to power cuts as winter approaches. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Taiwan receives first F-16V fighter jets amid China pressure
item.description: Taiwan has received its first F-16V fighter jets as part of an $8 billion deal with the United States. The delivery comes amid increasing military pressure from China. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Bolsters Middle East Military Presence Amid Iran Tensions
item.description: The United States is reportedly preparing to significantly increase its military presence in the Middle East, with plans to deploy an additional 10,000 troops and potentially a carrier strike group. This buildup comes as President Trump is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: China Expands Presence on Antelope Reef in South China Sea
item.description: Satellite images indicate that China is accelerating construction activities on Antelope Reef in the South China Sea. The latest imagery reveals a significant increase in the pace of work on the reef. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UAE Cancels Landing Rights, Stranding Israelis in Dubai
item.description: Israeli airline El Al has cancelled repatriation flights from Dubai after the United Arab Emirates withdrew landing permissions. These flights were intended to bring back Israeli citizens who were stranded in Dubai. Thousands of Israelis… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Pakistan Airstrikes in Afghanistan Kill at Least 9
item.description: Pakistan conducted airstrikes in Afghanistan, resulting in the deaths of at least nine people, according to reports. The majority of those killed were women and children. One report stated that 22 people died in Helmand province as a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Rushes Patriot Missiles to Saudi, Qatar Amid Iran Tensions
item.description: The United States is deploying Patriot missile systems to Saudi Arabia and Qatar to safeguard oil and gas facilities amid heightened tensions with Iran. This deployment comes as the US perceives a potential for Iranian retaliation… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US Troops Withdraw from Iraq After 12-Year Mission Against ISIS
item.description: The United States has completed the withdrawal of its troops from Iraq, concluding a 12-year mission focused on combating the Islamic State (ISIS). The operation, known as Operation Inherent Resolve, has officially ended. This withdrawal… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: US Clears $320 Million Arms Package for Egypt
item.description: The United States has cleared a $320 million military aid package for Egypt. This decision comes after Egypt's support during the Iran conflict. Senator Marco Rubio waived human rights restrictions that would have otherwise blocked the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Yemeni Leader Calls for Mobilization Against Houthis
item.description: Yemen's president has called for a general mobilization of his people to oppose the Houthis, whom he described as Iran-backed. The call for mobilization was reported by multiple outlets. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Zelenskyy Warns Countries as Russia Uses Foreign Recruits in Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has issued a warning to 47 countries, stating that Russia is employing foreign recruits in the ongoing war. Meanwhile, Russia has reportedly targeted Ukraine's data centers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 16 · Right 3.

item.title: Danish intelligence warns Russia may attack NATO country soon
item.description: Danish intelligence has warned that Russia could attack a NATO member country within months. The warning was issued by Denmark. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Turkey to transfer Bashiqa military base in Iraq to Baghdad
item.description: Turkey announced it will gradually transfer control of its Bashiqa military base in northern Iraq to the Iraqi government, according to a joint statement by the Turkish presidency and Baghdad. The handover follows progress in Iraqi… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 5 · Right 1.

item.title: Iran Offers US New Peace Proposal, Ceasefire Plan
item.description: Iran has presented a new proposal for peace talks and a seven-day ceasefire to the Trump administration. The details of the proposal were not disclosed in the coverage. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: North Korea Rejects International Call to Halt Nuclear Tests
item.description: North Korea has rejected an international call to halt its nuclear tests. The country has not provided further details on its stance. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China to send pandas back to Atlanta, Xi announces
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping announced that pandas will soon be sent to Atlanta. This move revives a diplomatic strategy, according to CNBC. The Print reported that Xi made the announcement regarding the pandas' return to Atlanta. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Nepal PM Praises India at UN, Proposes Himalaya Initiative
item.description: Nepal's Prime Minister Balen Shah addressed the United Nations, expressing strong praise for India and proposing an initiative related to the Himalayas. The specific details of the proposal were not elaborated upon in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: 80 Nations Demand Hormuz Strait Reopening, Condemn Iran and Houthis at UN
item.description: At the United Nations, 80 countries have jointly demanded the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and condemned attacks by Iran and the Houthis. The specific nature of these attacks and the context of the demand were not detailed in the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Iran President Defends Nuclear Enrichment Rights
item.description: Iranian President Ebrahim Raisi stated that Iran will not relinquish its right to civil nuclear enrichment. He defended the country's position on peaceful nuclear programs. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Committed to Defending Strait of Hormuz Amid Houthi Threat
item.description: US Senator Marco Rubio stated that the United States will "continue to defend" the Strait of Hormuz. He also affirmed the US commitment to a defense agreement with Saudi Arabia, in the context of threats from the Houthis. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US-Greenland Security Deal Expands Military Footprint in Arctic
item.description: The United States has finalized a security deal with Greenland aimed at expanding its military presence in the Arctic. The agreement allows for the expansion of U.S. military facilities and operations in the region. Key provisions of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Zelenskyy addresses UN, seeks end to Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is scheduled to address the UN General Assembly on Wednesday, aiming to convey the urgency of Ukraine's situation to world leaders. He is also seeking to shape renewed diplomatic efforts for an end… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 8 · Right 4.

item.title: UN Officials Urge Two-State Solution for Israel-Palestine Peace
item.description: At a United Nations meeting focused on achieving lasting peace between Israel and Palestine, UN officials Carney and Guterres called for a two-state solution. The meeting aimed to discuss pathways toward resolving the conflict. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: World Leaders Criticize UN Security Council Functionality
item.description: Multiple world leaders have stated that the UN Security Council is failing to function effectively. This sentiment was expressed across various international reports, highlighting a widespread concern about the council's operational… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Netanyahu to address UNGA, defend Israel's actions
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is scheduled to address the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA). He has stated his intention to defend Israel's actions during his address. Netanyahu vowed to "tell the truth" about Israel's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Pakistan Airstrikes in Afghanistan Spark Dispute Over Casualties
item.description: Pakistan conducted airstrikes in Afghanistan targeting militant hideouts, with Islamabad claiming 28 militants were killed. However, Kabul stated that only three people were killed in the attacks, identifying them as civilians. The… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 7 · Right 5.

item.title: Erdogan Calls for Gaza Rebuilding, UN Reform
item.description: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan has called for the immediate rebuilding of Gaza. He also urged for reform of the United Nations. The calls come despite a US-brokered ceasefire in October 2025, following which Israel has continued… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.
